changelog: v1.6.0 — ChatGPT writes CVs in real ChatGPT tabs, opened in the background (you keep your tab) and closed when done — no more hidden frames. Every chat it opens is still deleted afterwards, now even when a ChatGPT tab is closed by hand mid-write. Autofill, Remember and the Alt+Shift+F shortcut are removed; the profile card is just "Details" (click-to-copy). Fewer permissions.
